# thunder_gslb_service_matching_rules_rule (Resource)

`thunder_gslb_service_matching_rules_rule`: Service-matching rule

__PLACEHOLDER__



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `seq_num` (Number) Sequence number of rule
- `zone` (String) Zone

### Optional

- `domain_match_string` (String) Domain name string
- `domain_match_type` (String) 'equals': Domain name equals to string; 'contains': Domain name contains string; 'starts-with': Domain name starts with string; 'ends-with': Domain name ends with string;
- `health_state` (Block List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--health_state))
- `service` (String) Name of zone service to be redirected
- `src_ipv4` (String) Client source IPv4 subnet
- `src_ipv6` (String) Client source IPv6 subnet
- `user_tag` (String) Customized tag
- `uuid` (String) uuid of the object

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

### Nested Schema for `health_state`

Optional:

- `gslb_service_ip` (String) Health state of GSLB service-ip (GSLB service-ip name)
- `gslb_site` (String) Health state of GSLB site (GSLB site name)
- `service_ip_state` (String) 'Up': Up; 'Down': Down;
- `site_state` (String) 'AllUp': AllUp; 'Down': Down; 'AllUp-or-PartUp': AllUp-or-PartUp; 'Down-or-PartUp': Down-or-PartUp;
- `slb_server` (String) Health state of SLB server (SLB server name)
